scope: Public B-spline numerical optimizer resume only; no CI solve, gradient evaluation, or source edit performed by this audit.

mathematics.coordinates: For each complete same-kappa group, C_kappa = P_kappa Y_kappa, P_kappa^T S_kappa P_kappa = I and Y_kappa^T Y_kappa = I. The authoritative saved coordinate vector is the ordered flattening of all Y groups.
mathematics.tangent_projection: T_Y(G) = G - Y sym(Y^T G). Grouping all same-kappa columns together is necessary to enforce cross-orbital orthogonality; splitting one kappa across groups changes the constrained problem.
mathematics.gradient: The new functional supplies a newly evaluated radial CI-response gradient. Its coordinate gradient is T_Y(P^T g_radial). No stored old CI amplitudes, gradient, energies, occupations, or convergence flag may stand in for this evaluation.
mathematics.original_residual: The yardstick is ||T_Y(B_original T_Y(P^T g_radial))||_2. B_original is exactly the original positive inverse diagonal or ordered per-orbital inverse blocks, including its already-applied occupation scaling.
mathematics.original_energy_indicator: The unchanged indicator is 0.5 abs(g_coordinate^T T_Y(B_original g_coordinate)). It is a numerical stationarity diagnostic and does not bound experimental spectral error.
mathematics.basis_gauge: An orthogonal rotation of P can preserve the physical no-pair subspace but changes the coordinate representation and generally the stored inverse action. Exact original-metric restoration requires original bytes for P, coordinates and inverse data, not merely equal spans.
mathematics.positive_branch: S-orthonormality alone does not certify no-pair physics. Validate the complete selected positive span of the declared original nuclear or complete Fock operator, including the lower-root exclusions determined by the first active shell. Validation eigenvectors must not replace saved projectors.
mathematics.physical_geometry: Bind Z, ns, the full numerical B-spline workspace, actual nuclear one-body matrices, actual overlap matrices, nuclear-potential grid values, ordered orbital keys and source/operator declarations. Padded inactive DBSR components are null geometry and must not carry saved radial coefficients.
mathematics.history: Secant history is never imported, even for the same objective declaration. A changed CSF/EOL/tracking objective requires a fresh gradient, CI state, occupations and empty history while retaining B_original.
mathematics.inverse_noninvertibility: Original Fock fields cannot be reconstructed from inverse blocks: absolute spectral gaps, floors and occupation scaling lose sign, reference and operator information. A Fock projector must carry the original complete operator explicitly.
mathematics.accepted_point: Checkpoint state must describe an actual accepted coordinate point with the current re-evaluated CI and diagnostics. A wall-time stop occurs at such a point; a rejected line-search trial is not a resumable accepted certificate.

mandatory_rejections: Missing or repeated orbital keys, reordered keys, incomplete or duplicated same-kappa groups
Noninteger or nonpositive dimensions; overlapping, gapped or noncontiguous coordinate slices; wrong total coordinate length
Non-float64, nonfinite or complex projectors/coordinates/inverses; no casting away imaginary parts
Changed physical workspace, nucleus, overlap, one-body geometry, active component extents or orbital keys
Nonorthonormal saved coordinates or projectors, inactive padding leakage, wrong or incomplete selected positive subspace
Wrong inverse dimensions, missing per-column blocks, nonpositive inverse diagonal, nonsymmetric or nonpositive inverse blocks
Preconditioner matrices, refresh factory or shooting update policy combined with exact original-metric resume
Changed objective identity without an explicit allowance; optional input orbitals inconsistent with unpack(saved coordinates)
no_silent_repairs: No new Fock or nuclear projector construction used as the restored coordinate map
No seed polar normalization, reprojection or reconstructed original-successful coordinates
No new spectral gaps or reapplication of current occupations to saved inverse data
No clipping, symmetrizing, or repairing invalid saved projectors, overlaps or inverse blocks
No copying bare five-CSF stationarity, full-physical completeness or experimental certificate to the 531-CSF objective

scientific_boundary.objective_identity: A caller-supplied nonempty string records a declaration. It does not automatically verify CSF enumeration, angular phases, EOL weights, root matching or tracker identity. The physical successor contract must bind those inputs independently.
scientific_boundary.gate_arguments: The public fresh defaults are not the archived scientific gates. A successor using the original Yb yardstick must explicitly pass orbital tolerance 1e-7 and estimated-energy tolerance 1e-8 Ha, and report the actual values.
scientific_boundary.coordinate_recovery: The successful005 orbital archive did not store final x. Recovering x with P^T S C has a measured max radial reconstruction difference of 2.986638714119749e-13. It may define a disclosed new authoritative initial point, but cannot be called bitwise recovery of the missing final x.
scientific_boundary.hash_scope: The original residual SHA covers ordered list-key representations, P and inverse bytes. It does not bind S, nucleus, coordinate point, objective or tolerances. A stronger geometry/state hash is required in addition to keeping the legacy SHA unchanged.
scientific_boundary.MCDHF_solver: A public numerical optimizer resume entry point does not establish full MCDHFSolver initialization/resume integration. Root owns whether that integration is needed.
scientific_boundary.finite_differences: The future exact mixed-CI finite-energy-difference API remains separate. Resume must not silently extend fixed-density difference guards to mixed/tracked CI response.

review_plan: Review final owner source and focused tests against these invariants, record immutable hashes and report material source-bound findings. Do not rerun old scientific models or evaluate new CI/gradients.
